title: Fugue in C♯ minor

captions.text: ☞ Subject I in the bass: C♯, down to B♯, up to E, down to D♯.
☞ The tenor answers subject I on G♯.
☞ The alto enters with subject I, its first note now a half note.
☞ Soprano I enters last with subject I: all five voices are in.
☞ Subject II in soprano I: running eighths, then the same a step lower.
☞ The tenor turns subject II upside down.
☞ Subject III in the alto, with I and II above it: all three at once.
☞ The tenor answers subject III on G♯.
☞ Stretto of subject I: soprano I, soprano II, soprano I, then the bass.
☞ Subject III in soprano II and alto together, a third apart.
☞ Subject I a last time, in soprano II, on F♯.

listenFor: 5 voices; three subjects, one after another, then all three together
